scope: The former Army Museum street building at 7 Jana Kilińskiego in Białystok in its August 2020 museum configuration. Includes the three-storey exterior, projecting balconies, square-facing museum lettering and the rear. The adjacent building at number 7/1, museum exhibits and later site are outside scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The museum confirms the institution moved to 7 Jana Kilińskiego following the city’s 1974 allocation.
The commissioned assessment records three aboveground floors, attic and basement, a timber single-pitch roof and 304.6 square meters of footprint. Only the written facts are used.
